prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, redesign] Full bleed desktop layout for home intro screen: Redesign the final home intro screen to a full bleed immersive layout showcasing pet interaction highlights and clear launch instructions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen! Use simple mouse gestures to interact, move, or open settings."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality selection screen before friend selection: Insert a new screen 'new_pet_personality' before picking a friend to let users select their pet's temperament.
   config: {"new_pet_personality": {"headline": "Choose Your Pet's Personality", "body": "Select how active and vocal you want your desktop pet to be.", "layout": "card"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_pet_personality", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive story intro step before path selection: Add an interactive story choice screen 'new_story_intro' before choose_path screen to onboard users through an immersive story arc.
   config: {"new_story_intro": {"headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets World", "body": "Begin your journey by choosing how your companion will join your workspace.", "layout": "story_scroll"}, "_order": ["story", "new_story_intro", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pick friend step: Move sign-in screen to take place right after pick_friend, before upload_photos and adoption_certificate.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [home, wait_info] Show estimated generation timer on waiting screen: Display time estimate and progress bar clearly on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets are generated.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet Desktop Assets", "body": "Your pet is being customized and loaded onto your desktop background. This takes under 2 minutes."}}
5: [adoption, hint] Custom photo quality hint on upload screen: Add photo guidance hints and a helper text on the custom photo upload screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use a clear, front-facing photo with good lighting for best custom pet results.", "headline": "Upload Pet Photo"}}
6: [home, notification] Desktop ready background notification toggle on waiting screen: Add a system notification option on the waiting screen so users get notified when their pet creation finishes while working in other apps.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Generating Your Pet", "body": "Feel free to switch windows! We'll notify you when your pet is ready to play."}}
7: [finish, copy] Desktop pet controls quick reference headline and copy: Update headline and body text on home intro screen to explain mouse shortcuts and pet visibility controls clearly.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "How to Interact with Your Pet", "body": "Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen. Right-click for menu options to hide, feed, or summon your companion anytime!"}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption certificate progress counter and completion highlight: Enable step counter on adoption certificate screen with encouraging completion micro-copy.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Congratulations! Review and confirm your pet adoption certificate to finalize your new desktop companion."}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Two column layout for choose path screen: Switch choose_path screen layout to two_column for clearer side-by-side comparison of standard vs custom pet paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Select Your Adoption Path", "body": "Choose a pre-made companion or create a custom pet from your photos."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning home intro screen layout and copy inside onboarding is permitted.
Adding a personality selection step inside onboarding is permitted and retains all required steps.
Adding an interactive story intro screen inside onboarding is permitted and retains all required steps.
Reordering sign-in after pick friend step inside onboarding is explicitly permitted.
Adding time estimate and progress bar for a real wait duration on the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding photo guidance hints to the photo upload screen inside onboarding is permitted.
Adding a ready notification toggle on the waiting screen inside onboarding is permitted.
Updating interaction quick reference copy on home intro screen inside onboarding is permitted.
Adding a step counter and micro-copy to the adoption certificate screen is permitted.
Changing choose_path layout while maintaining options for both pre-made and custom pets is permitted.
